name: Pezzo - Tampines One
description:
MUST TRY: Indulge in their mouth-watering pizzas such as BBQ Bonanza, Cheesy Cheese, Hola Hawaiian, Pepperoni Party, Satay Sedap! and so much more! Pezzo Pizza is among the hottest pizza kiosks in town where customers can enjoy piping hot hand-crafted pizzas baked daily with fresh and premium ingredients. Best of all, customers can enjoy different kinds of pizza flavors at one go as their pizzas are sold by slices! Located at Tampines 1 (nearest train: Tampines MRT Station), Pezzo provides a vibrant atmosphere and is a great place to enjoy their pizzas together with family and friends. 
Source: hungrygowhere.com
